Just like a key and lock, the new Joie Collection embodies an unbreakable bond between two hearts, symbolising enduring love and protection. Inspired by the timeless Chinese lock and happiness motif, ‘喜’, Joie safeguards life’s most important moments while unlocking joy in its many forms. 就像鑰匙和鎖不可或缺一樣，傳喜系列展現了人與人之間牢不可破的緣份，象徵著永恒的愛和保護。 結合「喜」字與經典的中式「鎖」為靈感，傳喜系列以多種獨具中國特色的圖案，喚起每個難忘珍貴的時刻，守護美好的回憶。 #ChowTaiFook #周大福 #周大福傳喜系列 #JoieCollection #解鎖奇遇 #JoyUnlocked #CTFGold #GoldLegacy #CTFDiamond
